title: Cyclotron-web: one local check command and a repin procedure
description:
Repository: AnthusAI/Cyclotron-web. Standing rule: CI for private repos runs locally (no GitHub Actions minutes). Run the full gate locally before merging. Nothing in that repository runs its whole gate locally: npm test covers the recordings check and unit tests only; typecheck, build, the editorial Python tests (python -m unittest discover -s editorial -p 'test_*.py') and the infra tests (npm test --prefix infra) are separate commands, and the documented typecheck fails after a plain install because the root tsconfig.json:19 includes **/*.ts, so infra/bin/cyclotron-marketing.ts is type-checked and fails on a missing aws-cdk-lib until npm ci --prefix infra runs. The CodeBuild spec (infra/lib/cyclotron-marketing-pipeline-stack.ts:61) does that; the README's development steps do not. README.md:17 shows a stale pin (59d36c5) while package.json pins a565daf, README.md:115 references ../Decision-Flywheel/ (the old repo name), and there is no repin procedure in that repository (the only one is Cyclotron's docs/shared-priming-release.md).
Do: add npm run check (npm ci, npm ci --prefix infra, typecheck, test, infra test, editorial tests, build) and make scripts/require-main.mjs or the deploy path run it; add docs/repin.md (bump the tarball URL in package.json to a tagged release commit, npm install, npm run check, record the pin) and drop the literal hash from the README; fix the ../Decision-Flywheel reference; set license UNLICENSED in package.json. Also: scripts/og.mjs:6 hard-codes a macOS Chrome path and scripts/render-accountability-cover.mjs imports sharp, which is not a dependency; anthus-footer resolves over git+ssh with no integrity check (prefer a tarball URL like the cyclotron pin).
Done when: npm run check passes from a clean clone, the README's development section says to run it, docs/repin.md exists. Review doc: https://claude.ai/code/artifact/dcd5a089-28f1-4a3f-9f2f-a293789709c0 (Cyclotron review, 2026-10-17).
